limitations: This artifact is an execution packet for review only; it performs no provider call, SEC call, raw-payload parse, provider_samples write, runner change, or implementation.

The six planned FMP stable endpoint families were reviewed previously for response-shape candidates; the split / dividend candidate families are intentionally zero-call because current templates are not reviewed in repo evidence.
The planned SEC calls support parser and field-family feasibility review only; they do not implement a parser, generate fixtures, or authorize DataHub / runner consumption.

Any broader symbols, retries, endpoint families, yfinance check, new token, trial, paid plan, provider contact, full-market fetch, field mapping, parser implementation, fixture generation, return calculation, corporate-action reconciliation, provider selection, DataHub, Phase 7c, production readiness, or ship-gate evidence requires separate explicit approval and reviewed decision.
